ruleDefinitions.name: VHD Image Download Via Browser
ruleDefinitions.description:
Detects creation of ".vhd"/".vhdx" files by browser processes.
Malware can use mountable Virtual Hard Disk ".vhd" files to encapsulate payloads and evade security controls.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\brave\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\chrome\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\firefox\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\iexplore\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\maxthon\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\MicrosoftEdge\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\msedge\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\msedgewebview2\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\opera\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\safari\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\seamonkey\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\vivaldi\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\whale\\\.exe$")) AND file_path = RGX(".*\\\.vhd.*"))
